lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, specifically positioned within the recessed spaces between longitudinal carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits and continuing toward the caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance at the peak and a sharp shadow-induced gradient directly below each ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a low-density distribution of small, diffuse high-luminance spots, primarily clustered near the anterior base and becoming more sparse toward the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The upper lobe of the caudal fin exhibits significant irregular truncation and jagged posterior margins, indicating substantial tissue loss consistent with an old amputation or major predatory trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin features a significantly higher spatial frequency of smaller, more densely packed high-luminance spots compared to the primary lateral flank.
